main_body: Flat sand ground patch, 4x3 tiles of tan sand with sparse darker and lighter specks
top_band: none: terrain surface seen from above, not a standing object
evidence: This is a ground terrain tile, not a standing object, so the 3/4 top-plus-front contract does not apply. It has no raised volume, no fake front face and no side faces. Nothing in it breaks the contract.

style.evidence: The sand uses about four tones: a mid tan base, a darker tan, a light tan and a cream highlight. The reference grass and paving carry more steps, per-stone shading and tufts. Large areas of the base tan, around 5x5 px or more, are one flat colour between sparse single-pixel specks. The same 16px specks and short diagonal dashes repeat identically across the patch, which reads as mechanical tiling. There is no grain variation or ripple structure, so each tile holds only about 4-5 colours against the reference's roughly 10. It looks thinner than the reference.
